{{Top}}
[[File:BloodHuntingSylvar.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jedi Knight Sylvar, engaged in a ritual blood hunt.]]
{{Quote|I will go on a blood hunt. I can purge myself of the fury inside me&hellip;|Sylvar|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Blood Hunt'''<ref name="Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> were rituals among the [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Cathar (location)/Legends|same name]]<ref name="Redemption 4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 4]]</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the ritual, Cathar [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] would engage in single combat against entire nests of [[Kiltik]], in order to gain honor and purge themselves of inner darkness. [[Sylvar]], along with [[Tott Doneeta]], went on a blood hunt in [[3986 BBY]] at the urging of [[Kharr]], although the combat only served to fuel her anger.<ref name="Redemption 4" />
